catches: Only pursue this bonus with spending you were already going to make — manufactured or extra spending can erase the gain.
The Alaska Airlines Visa Signature has been renamed to the Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® — same issuer (Bank of America), same $95 fee; do not look for the old card name.

Offer terms vary by page: the dedicated Alaska/Atmos card page shows 70,000 points after $2,500 in 90 days; another Bank of America page shows a 50,000-point / $1,500-in-90-days variant — the page you apply from governs your offer.
'This offer may not be available elsewhere if you leave this page' — apply from the page showing the offer you want.
Applying for this card triggers a hard credit inquiry — do not apply unless you are ready for it.
This card's purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance can wipe out the entire bonus — pay the statement balance in full every month.
